rules.statement: The Fiscal is not a corporation sole with the right of perpetual succession, and that the successor in office of a Fiscal, in whose favour an obligation is created by bond, has no right to maintain an action on such bond, even where the obligation is created in favour of the said Fiscal and his successors in office.
rules.supporting_quote: Held , by Wendt J., that the Fiscal is not a corporation sole with the right of perpetual succession, and that the successor in office of a Fiscal, in whose favour an obligation is created by bond, has no right to maintain an action on such bond, even where the obligation is created in favour of the said Fiscal and his successors in office.
